summary: Cementos Pacasmayo filed a 6-K disclosing a Peruvian material event: Holcim Ltd. amended its Schedule 13D after acquiring 99.99% of Inversiones Aspi from the Hochschild-related sellers under a December 15, 2025 share purchase agreement, obligating a tender offer for at least 24.99% of Pacasmayo shares. On June 15, 2026, Holcim's executive committee expanded the offer to all common shares; the SMV granted Inversiones Aspi an exemption to make the bid, and independent valuer MSRA submitted its minimum-price report October 14, 2026. The offer, covering ADSs, has not yet launched.
